name: Simplesat
description_en:
Simplesat collects customer-satisfaction feedback in the tools a support team already uses. It can place a rating in a helpdesk email, capture that first click, and attach subsequent comments or answers to the same response. Scores and comments can return to the original ticket, giving agents feedback without requiring each agent to use a separate reporting account.

Its emphasis is support operations: satisfaction metrics, follow-up questions, reporting and rules for notifying the right people. Plan selection depends on response volume, account users, brands and features such as multilingual surveys or SSO. The presence of an integration name does not mean every helpdesk receives the same fields or can create the same follow-up objects.
description_zh:
Simplesat 在支持团队已经使用的工具中收集客户满意度反馈。它可把评分嵌入客服邮件，记录客户第一次点击，并把后续评论或答案补入同一条回答。评分与评论能够回到原工单，让坐席在既有工作界面看到反馈，无需人人另开报表账户。

产品重点是客服运营，包括满意度指标、追问、报表，以及通知相关人员的规则。套餐选择取决于回答量、管理账户数、品牌数，以及多语言问卷或 SSO 等功能。出现某个集成名称，不代表每种客服系统都能接收相同字段或创建相同后续对象。

core_features.explanation_en: The first email click records the rating; comments enrich that response.
core_features.explanation_zh: 邮件中的首次点击会记录评分，评论再补充到同一条回答。

core_features.explanation_en: Follow-up logic is included on every plan; question visibility rules start on Pro.
core_features.explanation_zh: 各套餐包含追问逻辑，问题可见性规则从 Pro 起提供。

core_features.explanation_en: Current rules combine score, sentiment and the presence of a written comment.
core_features.explanation_zh: 现有规则可组合评分、情绪和是否包含文字评论。

en: Capture CSAT after a resolved support ticket.
Send a low score with a comment to a manager channel.
zh: 把带评论的低评分发到经理频道。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose the metric and helpdesk trigger, then add the survey to an existing touchpoint.
steps.zh: 选择指标和客服触发条件，把问卷加入现有触点。

steps.en: Configure sender authentication if sending from your domain and check rating-to-ticket attribution.
steps.zh: 使用自有域名发送时配置认证，并核对评分与工单归属。

steps.en: Test one low and one high rating, follow-up logic, suppression and notification destination.
steps.zh: 分别测试低分与高分、追问逻辑、发送抑制和通知目标。

items.en: Topic, tag, customer-segment and agent routing are described as roadmap items, not current general functionality.
items.zh: 按主题、标签、客户分组和坐席路由列为路线图内容，不能视为当前普遍可用功能。

items.en: SMS surveys are links sent through an existing SMS or phone system; Simplesat does not directly text customers in that described flow.
items.zh: 短信问卷通过现有短信或电话系统发送链接；所述流程不是由 Simplesat 直接给客户发短信。

pricing.billing_basis: Monthly or annual subscription tier by response volume, account users and brands; add-on response capacity available.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter lists $149/month or $119/month billed annually for 300 responses/month, 5 account users and 1 brand. Pro lists $299/$249, Premium $599/$499 and Scale $999/$829 on the same monthly/annual display. Enterprise is quoted. The trial is fourteen days without a credit card. Paid agent feedback is unlimited within the account’s response capacity; this does not remove administrator or brand limits.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 月付 $149，年付折合每月 $119，含每月 300 条回答、5 个管理账户和 1 个品牌。相同月付/年付展示下，Pro 为 $299/$249，Premium 为 $599/$499，Scale 为 $999/$829；Enterprise 询价。试用 14 天，无需信用卡。套餐允许为不限数量坐席收集反馈，但仍受账户回答容量约束，也不取消管理账户或品牌数限制。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow a rating back to the original service interaction
sections.title_zh: 让评分可以追溯到原服务交互
sections.en:
A typical Simplesat workflow begins in a helpdesk message. The first click records a rating even if the customer does not complete the follow-up page; comments and later answers enrich the same response. That means a rating-only response should not be confused with a fully completed multi-question survey.

For an illustrative resolved-ticket flow, preserve the ticket identifier, the responsible agent and the customer context. Check that feedback is attached to the intended ticket and that a reopened conversation does not receive an ill-timed satisfaction request. Simplesat describes send delays, suppression rules and exclusions for this purpose; we did not execute them.
sections.zh:
典型流程从客服邮件开始。客户首次点击就记录评分，即使没有完成后续页面；评论及后续答案再补充到同一条记录。因此，只有评分的回答不能与完成全部追问的问卷混为一谈。

例如工单解决后的流程，应保留工单标识、负责坐席和客户上下文，并核对反馈确实挂到正确工单、重新打开的对话不会过早收到满意度请求。Simplesat 为此介绍发送延迟、频率抑制和排除规则，本文未实际执行。

sections.title_en: Keep the follow-up and language requirements within the chosen tier
sections.title_zh: 按套餐核对追问和语言需求
sections.en:
The survey page describes CSAT, NPS, CES and star ratings, with multiple-choice, scale and comment questions. Follow-up question logic is included on every plan, while question visibility rules begin on Pro. Custom CSS and a custom survey URL are also Pro-and-above capabilities. Multilingual surveys require Premium, Scale or Enterprise.

For a low-rating branch, ask for a useful explanation and check what happens if the respondent leaves immediately. Survey translation is separate from the language of the administrator interface. The Chinese text of this catalog profile provides no evidence about the software’s interface localization.
sections.zh:
问卷页介绍 CSAT、NPS、CES、星级评分，以及选择、量表和评论题。各套餐都包含追问逻辑，问题可见性规则则从 Pro 开始。自定义 CSS 与问卷域名也是 Pro 及以上能力；多语言问卷需要 Premium、Scale 或 Enterprise。

低评分分支应追问有用原因，并检查回答者立即离开时保留什么。问卷翻译与管理界面的语言是两回事，本目录的中文档案不能证明软件界面已本地化。

sections.title_en: Use today’s routing rules, not the roadmap
sections.title_zh: 使用现有分发条件，不套用路线图
sections.en:
The routing FAQ is more specific than the general homepage: current rules combine score, sentiment and whether a comment exists. Topic, tag, customer-segment and agent rules are described as roadmap items. A requirement to alert a particular team by one of those attributes therefore needs confirmation, not an assumption.

Negative feedback can create a follow-up ticket, case or issue only where the particular integration supports it. Scores may return as comments, tags or custom fields depending on the helpdesk. For a proposed rollout, validate the resulting object and notification channel with a disposable ticket. Enterprise includes custom integration work; a marketing promise to build workflows is not an entitlement on every plan.
sections.zh:
分发 FAQ 比首页概述更具体：现有规则可以组合评分、情绪及是否有评论；按主题、标签、客户分组和坐席的规则列在路线图中。若需求依赖这些属性来通知某个团队，必须确认，不能直接假定。

只有特定集成支持时，负面反馈才能创建后续工单、案件或问题。根据客服系统不同，评分可能作为评论、标签或自定义字段回写。建议先用可丢弃工单核对结果对象与通知频道。定制集成属于 Enterprise，宣传中的定制流程并非所有套餐权益。

sections.title_en: Model responses, accounts and brands separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计算回答、管理账户和品牌
sections.en:
Starter includes 300 monthly responses, five account users and one brand at $149 monthly or $119 per month billed annually. Pro raises those allowances to 1,000 responses, ten users and two brands; Premium to 2,500, fifteen and three; Scale to 5,000, twenty and four. Enterprise provides a custom volume and requirements discussion.

Unlimited agents means people receiving feedback in their helpdesk do not each need a paid Simplesat account. It does not mean unlimited survey builders, brands or response capacity. Before purchasing, estimate received responses rather than tickets alone, and ask about capacity packs and what remains visible after crossing the allowance. The fourteen-day trial is not an ongoing free subscription.
sections.zh:
Starter 每月含 300 条回答、5 个管理账户和 1 个品牌，月付 $149，年付折合每月 $119。Pro 提升为 1,000 条、10 人和 2 品牌；Premium 为 2,500 条、15 人和 3 品牌；Scale 为 5,000 条、20 人和 4 品牌。Enterprise 按容量及具体需求询价。

不限坐席表示在客服系统内接收反馈的人不需要每人购买一个 Simplesat 账户，不表示问卷创建者、品牌和回答量也不限。购买前应估算实际收到的回答而不只是工单数，并确认容量包和超额后的可见性。14 天试用不等于持续免费订阅。

sections.title_en: Evaluate delivery, reporting and operational ownership
sections.title_zh: 核对送达、报表与运营责任
sections.en:
For surveys sent from a customer domain, Simplesat describes DNS authentication and delivery statistics. For SMS, the survey travels as a link through the existing SMS system; it is not a direct Simplesat texting service. Automated spam detection and first-click recording still warrant a check with your actual mail-security tooling before using scores as a KPI.

Shortlist the hosted product for recurring support feedback where ticket attribution and follow-up matter. Large standalone research studies or a required self-hosted installation need separate evaluation. No source-code license or deployable server was verified, and this profile does not independently audit the vendor’s security or delivery claims.
sections.zh:
通过客户域名发送问卷时，Simplesat 介绍 DNS 认证和送达统计。短信场景通过既有短信系统发送问卷链接，不是 Simplesat 直接发送短信。即使有自动垃圾回答检测和首次点击采集，也建议结合真实邮件安全工具核对后，再把评分用于 KPI。

对于重视工单归属与后续处理的持续客服反馈，可以考虑这一托管产品；大型独立研究或强制自托管需求应另行评估。本次未确认源码许可或可部署服务端，也未独立审计厂商的安全或送达主张。

research_gaps: No account, helpdesk trigger, DNS authentication, bot filtering, ticket writeback or alert delivery was tested.
Routing by topic, tag, customer segment and agent was described as roadmap; availability requires vendor confirmation.
Contractual overage treatment, storage location, retention, source license, self-hosting and administrator interface languages remain unverified.
